paper.title_en: Quantum critical collapse in the large $D$ limit
paper.abstract_en: In analytically tractable models of Einstein-scalar critical collapse, it has been shown that the quantum self-energy of the collapsing matter in the dominant $s$-wave sector grows with Lyapunov exponent $D-2$, eventually competing with the classical instability that controls black hole formation. This competition shifts the naked singularity threshold and produces a finite mass gap within semiclassical control, yet that control may appear threatened as the spacetime dimension $D\to\infty$. We study this quantum growing mode in both continuously (CSS) and discretely (DSS) self-similar critical spacetimes at large $D$ and establish that the universal Lyapunov exponent survives both forms of self-similarity. In CSS, the classical approach to a naked singularity is interrupted by the appearance of trapped surfaces. At large $D$, the horizon tracing reduces to a Bessel problem, yielding a quantum wall whose radius obeys $r_h\propto(D-2)^{-2}$. This radius can remain above the Planck scale at finite $D$, although maintaining this hierarchy becomes increasingly demanding as $D$ grows. In DSS, the same growth is modulated by echoing and can retain memory of previous echoes. The simplest anomaly-induced action exhibits accumulating memory but is singular at the spherical center. We construct a covariant one-loop action whose stress tensor remains smooth throughout the DSS domain and organize it into an echo-periodic structure without memory. This suggests that the smooth vacuum polarization of the genuine four-dimensional DSS Choptuik spacetime may similarly be governed by its exact echoing symmetry.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究大D极限下Einstein-scalar临界坍缩中的量子增长模式，涉及裸奇点阈值移动、视界追踪化为Bessel问题以及DSS回波对称性，理论深度高，方法具有解析可处理性，对引力的基础问题有实质推进，值得点读。
decision.title_zh: 大 $D$ 极限下的量子临界坍缩
decision.abstract_zh: 在解析可处理的 Einstein-scalar 临界坍缩模型中，已经表明：占主导的 $s$-波扇区中坍缩物质的量子自能随 Lyapunov 指数 $D-2$ 增长，最终与控制黑洞形成的经典不稳定性相竞争。这种竞争移动了裸奇点阈值，并在半经典控制范围内产生了一个有限质量间隙，然而当时空维数 $D\to\infty$ 时，这种控制可能看似受到威胁。我们研究了连续自相似（CSS）和离散自相似（DSS）临界时空在大 $D$ 下的这一量子增长模式，并确认普适的 Lyapunov 指数在两种自相似形式下都存活。在 CSS 中，经典地趋向裸奇点的过程被俘获面的出现所打断。在大 $D$ 下，视界追踪约化为一个 Bessel 问题，产生一堵量子墙，其半径满足 $r_h\propto(D-2)^{-2}$。在有限 $D$ 下，该半径可以保持在普朗克尺度以上，尽管随着 $D$ 增大，维持这一层级变得越来越困难。在 DSS 中，同样的增长受到回波的调制，并可能保留先前回波的记忆。最简单的反常诱导作用量表现出累积记忆，但在球心处奇异。我们构造了一个协变单圈作用量，其应力张量在整个 DSS 区域内保持光滑，并将其组织成无记忆的回波周期结构。这暗示，真正的四维 DSS Choptuik 时空的光滑真空极化可能同样由其精确的回波对称性所支配。
